coder_notes: Early Phase 1 microdialysis trial. Glioblastoma is not named anywhere (conditions: diffuse/malignant glioma; eligibility: diffuse high grade glioma or prior diffuse glioma), so S5 fails as high_grade_glioma_unspecified. Arm II is registered PLACEBO_COMPARATOR (placebo days 1-2 then both drugs) and Arm III ACTIVE_COMPARATOR (DFMO alone days 1-2 then both); all arms end up on both drugs, so roles coded as in the combination arm. Placebo not listed as an agent (no registered placebo intervention).
